texts: In the late summer of Year 1, one day before the autumn equinox, the salt-bloom store at Cauldron Hall held ten weeks of winter supply.
Hesper reported to the Council that the previous new-moon harvest had been thin.

q2_gaps: A non-deictic season as a time granularity ('the late summer of Year 1'): Time terms cover Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, and seasons appear only as speech-anchored deictic constants ('last_spring', 'next_summer'); nothing licenses a bare season symbol composed with a stated (Year n), nor the internal 'late' modifier on it.

A measure / container 'of' phrase ('ten weeks of winter supply', the instruction set's own 'a cup of water'): it is explicitly excluded from the genitive Possession mapping but is given no positive encoding anywhere, so the quantity-of-a-mass construction has no stated form.

An anaphoric / relational temporal adjective restricting a definite ('the previous new-moon harvest'): it fails the predication test so it cannot be a Member property, and an ordering atom may not cross the attitude seal, so the restriction has no licensed carrier and is silently lost.
review.notes: Stative-transitive Agent for 'held', the BeforeBy measured gap on the event-noun anchor, the non-factive seal with its projected definite typing plus compound-genus atoms, and the no-Name default for 'the Council' all follow the instruction set exactly. The three items above are holes in the instruction set rather than parse errors; the parse's late_summer and Measure-with-'unspecified' choices are reasonable improvisations within them.
